# 03 Augment

## Purpose

Create derived variables and analysis-ready structure.

## Input / Output

|            | File                    |
|------------|-------------------------|
| **Reads**  | `data/02_dat_clean.tsv` |
| **Writes** | `data/03_dat_aug.tsv`   |

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: 03_setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
source(here("R", "99_proj_func.R"))
```

## Load data

```{r}
#| label: 03_load-data
dat_clean <- read_tsv(here("data", "02_dat_clean.tsv"))
sample_metadata_clean <- read_tsv(here("data", "02_sample_metadata_clean.tsv"))
```

## Initial checks

```{r}
#| label: 03_checks

# Extract sample IDs from the expression matrix, excluding probe_id and gene_id
sample_ids <- colnames(dat_clean)[-c(1, 2)]

# Check that sample IDs match the metadata and are in the same order
identical(sample_ids, sample_metadata_clean$sample_id)

# Extract expression values as a numeric matrix
expression_values <- dat_clean |>
  select(-probe_id, -gene_id) |>
  as.matrix()

# Count negative expression values
sum(expression_values < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Count zero expression values
sum(expression_values == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Count missing expression values
sum(is.na(expression_values))

# Summarize the distribution of expression values
summary(as.vector(expression_values))

# Count negative expression values per sample
colSums(expression_values < 0)

# Calculate the percentage of negative values per sample
round(colMeans(expression_values < 0) * 100, 2)

# Inspect the structure and column types of the dataset
str(dat_clean)

# Check the dimensions (number of rows and columns)
dim(dat_clean)
```
## Convert group into factor

```{r}
#| label: 03_convert

metadata_aug <- sample_metadata_clean |>
  mutate(
    tissue_group = factor(
      tissue_group,
      levels = c('Normal breast','Tumour')
    )
  )

#checks
levels(metadata_aug$tissue_group)

table(metadata_aug$tissue_group)

str(metadata_aug)
```



## Save output

```{r}
#| label: 03_save
saveRDS(
  metadata_aug,
  here("data", "03_sample_metadata_aug.rds")
)
```
